preprocess_images_idefics2: preprocess a list of PIL images for Idefics2 using resize, rescale, normalize, and pad operations
resize_images_idefics2: resize PIL images for Idefics2 using shortest_edge and longest_edge size constraints
split_images_idefics2: split an image into 4 equal sub-images and concatenate them with the original image
pad_images_idefics2: pad images to a target size and generate pixel attention masks for Idefics2
convert_images_to_rgb: convert PIL images to RGB format handling RGBA and other non-RGB modes
